name: What is the process for rebuilding a deck with Hometelligent Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for rebuilding a deck with Hometelligent Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our deck rebuilding process begins with an initial consultation and site visit to assess the existing structure, discuss your vision, and understand your needs. We then provide a detailed proposal and design plan. Upon approval and securing any necessary permits, our team will demolish the old deck, prepare the site, construct the new deck, and complete a final inspection. We aim for clear communication throughout each stage, from planning to the final walkthrough, ensuring the project aligns with your expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, proposal, permitting, demolition, construction, and a final inspection, with continuous communication.
